## ⛔ Sequenced behind #6308 — and triage's fold suggestion declined, with the reason

Posted by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_012CZgmFFzqA9cX8tBMhvpFe`, R33. ⛔ Not claiming this card yet; it stays `pm:queue` and unassigned.

### Triage proposed folding this into #6308

> **Fold candidate**: #6280 is stale claims on the same page; one PR covering both keeps the doc's revision history clean.

The reasoning is sound and I am **not** taking it. Two reasons, stated so the decision is reviewable rather than silent:

1. **This seat dispatches one card per agent.** That is a standing constraint on the execution seat, not a preference I can trade against PR hygiene. A folded dispatch would also blur which card each report and each rework round belongs to.
2. Triage's note is a **routing suggestion**, not a ruling on how to fix either card. ⛔ Declining it changes nothing about either card's substance.

⚠️ The cost is real and I am stating it rather than hiding it: two PRs will touch `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` in sequence instead of one, which is slower and leaves a slightly noisier revision history than triage would have preferred. If the maintainer would rather have the fold, say so and I will dispatch it as one.

### Why sequenced rather than parallel

⚠️ `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` has been the contended file **three times in R32 alone**, and two of those cost a rework round:

- PR #6389 landed mid-flight and moved the base blob under PR #6398, whose green pin run was against a tree that no longer existed;
- PR #6402 added a workflow and went red on that page's bidirectional pin for not documenting it.

⛔ So this card and #6308 do not run in parallel, and neither starts while a PR editing that page is still open. #6308 is dispatched now; **this card follows once #6308's PR has landed**.

⭐ Worth recording as a lane fact rather than a PM's memory: this page is a merge-conflict magnet of the same shape CLAUDE.md already names for `content/docs/releases/` — a file that every change in a class must touch. The difference is that this one is *pinned in both directions*, so the cost arrives as a red CI run rather than a silent conflict.

Related: #6308 (dispatched R33) · the R32 closing brief on #5748

## Dispatch order — R33

Claimed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_012CZgmFFzqA9cX8tBMhvpFe`. Branch: **`claude/issue-6280-scan-surface-claims`**. Assignee is this seat's shared identity — the claim is this comment plus the session ID.

### The ruling you are executing (triage, 2026-08-25T18:09:59Z — verbatim)

> Triage: promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` (keeping `domain:devx`), type **Task**. Both halves in one docs/docblock pass: (a) rewrite the `readme-shadcn-sync-categories` scan-surface docblock to argue from the tree as it is post-#4938 — keeping the test if its checks exceed what `check-doc-links` asserts, which the dev verifies rather than assumes; (b) update both frozen surface lists in `ci-cd-pipeline.md` to the post-#6026 surface. Fold candidate with #6308 (same page, different section — one PR); serial: land after the open #6274, which edits the same file.

⛔ **The fold with #6308 is declined by this seat** — one card per agent. #6308 has already landed its own PR; do not revisit its section.

### ⚠️ Two facts in that ruling are stale — I checked, and you should not inherit either

1. **"the open #6274" is not open.** #6274 is a **pull request**, and it was **closed unmerged** at 2026-08-25T07:42:30Z by its author. It is not an active neighbour and nothing about it constrains your ordering. ⛔ Do not wait for it and do not merge around it.
2. **A consequence you must not trip over**: because #6274 never merged, everything it measured is *still true of the page today*. It found that `ci-cd-pipeline.md` asserts:

   > *"The label still does not exist (checked against the labels API, 2026-08-08 — of the two names only `dependencies` exists…)"*

   and measured via `get_label` that **`skip-changeset` does exist**. So the page carries a second false claim, in a different section from yours.

   ⛔ **That is NOT your card.** It belongs to #4912, which is claimed by another identity. Do not fix it, do not fold it in, do not mention it in your changeset. If your edits happen to sit near it, leave it alone. ⚠️ I am telling you it is there only so you do not "discover" it mid-task and widen your PR.

### The work — both halves, as ruled

**(a) `packages/components/src/__tests__/readme-shadcn-sync-categories.test.ts:96`** — the `## Scan surface` docblock says `README_SHADCN_SYNC.md` has *"never been scanned by anything"* and that widening the scan root *"is a separate change with its own entry price"*. ⛔ Both became false with #4938: `scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`'s `packages/*` row excludes only the basenames `README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md`, and `README_SHADCN_SYNC.md` is neither — it **is** scanned today.

⚠️ The sentence is **load-bearing**: it is the stated reason that test does its own path checking. So rewriting it is not cosmetic — someone deciding whether the hand-rolled checking can be retired reads it.

⭐ **Verify, do not assume, whether the test should survive.** The ruling is explicit: keep it *if its checks exceed what `check-doc-links` asserts*. Read both and say which assertions the test makes that the link checker does not. ⛔ If it turns out the test is fully subsumed, do **not** delete it on your own judgement — report that and hand back; retiring a test is a decision, not a cleanup.

**(b) `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`** — the page describes `check-doc-links.mjs`'s surface **twice** (prose ~`:406`, the two-link-checkers table ~`:972`) and both end at *"the internal `docs/` tree and every package `README.md`"* — the surface as of #3622. It has been widened three times since: #4148 (app READMEs, remaining root-level markdown), #4938 (the `packages/*` / `apps/*` trees), #6026 / PR #6279 (nested `README.md` via `packages/*/*` collect rows).

⚠️ **Re-derive the current surface from `check-doc-links.mjs` itself**, not from that table of three cards. The card's line numbers are from `ef2a3bd8d` this morning and the page has been edited four times today — by PRs #6389, #6398, #6402 and #6408. ⭐ The gate prints its own verdict naming the scan-root count (`Links are valid across N scan roots`); that number is a cheap cross-check on whether your rewritten list matches reality.

### ⚠️ Before your first edit to that page

`content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` has been contended **four times today** and two of those cost a rework round. **PR #6408 is armed and in the merge queue right now.**

1. Create the worktree, `git fetch origin main`, and confirm #6408 has landed (`git log origin/main --oneline -- content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`).
2. If it has not, **wait and re-check** before touching that file. ⛔ Never edit a stale copy.
3. Branch from, or merge in, a `main` containing it. ⛔ Never rebase, never force-push.

### Constraints

- ⛔ **Worktree-first**: `git worktree add ../objectui-6280 -b claude/issue-6280-scan-surface-claims main && cd ../objectui-6280 && pnpm install`.
- ⛔ **Never `git stash`** — the stack is shared across every worktree of this repo.
- ⛔ **Never touch `content/docs/releases/`.**
- ⛔ Do not set `domain:*` or type labels; file findings **unassigned**.
- ⚠️ Run the **whole** `scripts/__tests__` tree plus the `packages/components` test you are editing. This page carries at least three separate pins and a subset chosen from your own subject matter will miss the ones that fire on the page as a whole — that cost PR #6402 a round today.
- Changeset required. Open the PR as **draft**; this seat arms it.

### Reporting

Structured JSON report: the current scan surface **re-derived from the script** with the commands, the assertion-by-assertion comparison deciding whether the test survives, both rewritten lists, and the full-tree counts.

## Review — ACCEPT (PR #6410)

Reviewed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_012CZgmFFzqA9cX8tBMhvpFe`, R33. Read the diff.

### ⭐ The ruling asked for a verification, not an assumption — and the verification changed the *reason*, not the outcome

Triage required the test be kept *"if its checks exceed what `check-doc-links` asserts, which the dev verifies rather than assumes."* The old docblock's conclusion — keep the hand-rolled path checking — turns out to be **right for a reason that is now false**. It said no link gate can see the file. Since #4938, one does.

The replacement gives two reasons that hold *regardless of scan surface*, and both are measured:

1. **`check-doc-links.mjs` cannot see the paths this file names.** Every in-repo path here is a backticked code span, never `[text](href)`, and the gate's own `stripCode()` blanks inline code spans **before** the link regex runs — by design, so that `` `pnpm shadcn:update button` `` is not misread as a broken link. The README's only real markdown links are 8, all external.
2. **It has no notion of the defect class.** #3881 was two prose censuses disagreeing with `shadcn-components.json` — a comparison against a JSON manifest. ⛔ No widening of `SCAN_ROOTS`, at any width, gives a link checker that question to ask.

⭐ The line that settles it: *"the #3881 path drift … would go just as uncaught by that gate under today's widened surface as it did before #4938."* That is the proof the two facts are **orthogonal** — the scan surface reaching this file says nothing about whether the test earns its keep. A weaker pass would have read "it's scanned now" and either deleted the test or kept it on the old, now-false sentence.

### Half (b)

Both frozen lists re-derived from the **live `SCAN_ROOTS`** rather than from the card's three-card changelog, and cross-checked against the gate's own printed verdict (`Links are valid across 17 scan roots`) — the cheap independent check I asked for, actually taken. The prose and the two-link-checkers table now agree with each other and with the script.

### Sequencing

Waited for PR #6408 to land before touching the page, and staged half (b) rather than editing a stale copy. That page has now been contended **five times today**; this is the third consecutive PR to handle it before the collision instead of after.

### Disposition

⛔ Arming on **every** check green, not the required subset. 28 checks running on `bd2ce2ab` (Bundle Analysis is in this one, since the diff reaches `packages/components/**`). No failures so far. Arms when clean.
